changelog:
- Initial release introducing a guided, structured workflow for co-authoring documentation, proposals, and technical specs.
- Guides users through three stages: Context Gathering, Refinement & Structure, and Reader Testing.
- Offers tailored context-gathering, including info dumps and integration with team docs and messaging platforms.
- Iterative, section-by-section refinement via clarifying questions, brainstorming, structured feedback, and collaborative drafting.
- Supports artifact creation and integration, with fallbacks for different environments.
- Special support for checking images, encouraging accessibility, and utilizing available connectors.
